brief: Holds one call of a function with a list of up to ten parameters, recording its status, result and error.
detail: It is the task a stzReactiveFunc makes. Execute calls the function with the parameters and records completed with the result, or error with the real reason; it refuses a params value that is not a list and more than ten parameters with a message saying so. Then_ and Catch_ come from stzReactiveTask. The error mode is the default, which prints a failure to the console.
receiver:
oEngine = new stzReactive()
o1 = new stzFunctionTask("add", func a, b { return a + b }, [ 2, 3 ], oEngine)
